clips.title: The story
paras: Break Sharptusk! is a decisive rite of passage issued by Brave Windfeather on Red Cloud Mesa. To secure the tauren homeland against ongoing raids, young champions are sent east into Brambleblade Ravine to slay Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle. Eliminating the Bristleback chieftain strikes a severe blow against the quilboar encroaching upon Mulgore.

The grassy heights of Red Cloud Mesa have long served as a peaceful sanctuary where young tauren learn the traditions of the hunt and attunement with the Earth Mother. However, this peace is constantly contested. To the east lies Brambleblade Ravine, a thorn-choked gulch claimed by the hostile Bristleback quilboar tribe. The quilboar view the tauren as invaders stealing sacred ground, launching relentless skirmishes against the tribes attempting to establish a stable life in Mulgore.

The persistent attacks on the mesa are not aimless frenzy; they are coordinated under the brutal leadership of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle. Residing in a fortified makeshift village deep within the ravine, Sharptusk directs his warriors and geomancers against the Shu'halo. Recognizing that the Bristleback will never cease their raids while their chief still draws breath, Brave Windfeather commands an aspiring hero to breach the ravine, strike down Thornmantle, and return with his severed head as proof.

For young tauren and their allies, hunting Sharptusk is more than a simple execution—it is an initiation into the harsh realities of survival. As Brave Windfeather teaches, the hunt against beasts teaches patience, but hunting an enemy cunning enough to hunt back tests courage, awareness, and martial discipline. Bringing down Sharptusk delivers justice for fallen kin and marks the hunter's readiness to venture out into the wider plains of Mulgore.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend - I have heard of you, newcomer. Perhaps it is you that will help us, where others have failed.

We traveler have carved a home out of this land, but not without a cost. The Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, have made our lives difficult with their continued war against us. I charge you to bring me the chief's head!
He will be found in the ravine to the east in their makeshift village.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death. It is his head that I seek, friend.

We traveler live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back. If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Justice has been served on this day by your swift actions, friend. Let this deed serve as a warning to all who would threaten our home.
You have earned this reward to help you on your sojourn, young adventurer.
